join_requested.title: New request to join
join_requested.body: {name} wants to join {gameTitle}. Approve or reject the request.

join_approved.title: You’re in
join_approved.body: The host approved you for {gameTitle} on {time}.

join_rejected.title: Request not accepted
join_rejected.body: The host couldn’t accept your request for {gameTitle}. Other games are waiting for you on the map.

join_waitlisted.title: You’re on the waitlist
join_waitlisted.body: {gameTitle} is full. You’re #{position} on the waitlist, and we’ll tell you if a spot opens.

waitlist_offer.title: A spot is open for you
waitlist_offer.body: A spot opened up in a game you’re waitlisted for. Accept it in the app before the offer expires.

participant_removed.title: You were removed from a game
participant_removed.body: The host removed you from {gameTitle}. Open the game for details.

game_cancelled.title: Game cancelled
game_cancelled.body: {gameTitle} on {time} was cancelled by the host.

game_reminder.title: Game coming up
game_reminder.body: {gameTitle} starts at {time}. Check-in opens {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before.

checkin_open.title: Check-in is open
checkin_open.body: Check in to {gameTitle} when you arrive.

result_requested.title: How did it go?
result_requested.body: Enter the result of {gameTitle}. You have {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} left.

sanction_issued.title: Update on your account
sanction_issued.body: We’ve made a decision about your account. Tap to see what happened and how to appeal.

sanction_decided.title: Decision on your account
sanction_decided.body: A moderator reviewed your account. Open the app to read the decision and the reasons.

appeal_decided.title: Your appeal has been decided
appeal_decided.body: {outcome, select, overturned {We reversed the decision. Open the app for details.} upheld {The decision stands. Open the app to read the reasons.} other {Open the app to read the decision.}}

visibility_restricted.title: Your profile is less visible
visibility_restricted.body: For the next {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}, other players will see your profile less. Open the app to see why.

chat_muted.title: Chat paused
chat_muted.body: You can’t send messages until {time}. Open the app to see why.

venue_hidden.title: A venue is under review
venue_hidden.body: {venueName} is hidden while we review reports about it.

deposit_action_required.title: Action needed for your deposit
deposit_action_required.body: We need you to confirm the {amount} deposit hold for {gameTitle}. Open the app to continue.

roster_added.title: {via, select, invite_link {New regular for {seriesTitle}} other {You’re invited to the regulars}}
roster_added.body: {via, select, invite_link {A player joined {seriesTitle} through your link.} other {Join the regulars of {seriesTitle} to get first pick of every date.}}

series_reconfirm.title: Still in for {seriesTitle}?
series_reconfirm.body: Confirm your spot by {deadline}, or it goes to the next player. No penalty either way.

series_auto_released.title: Your spot was released
series_auto_released.body: You didn’t confirm for {seriesTitle}, so your spot went to the next player. No penalty.

roster_leave_offer.title: Still playing {seriesTitle}?
roster_leave_offer.body: {misses, plural, one {You missed # date in a row. Stay a regular or leave the roster, no penalty.} other {You missed # dates in a row. Stay a regular or leave the roster, no penalty.}}

occurrence_skipped.title: A date of {seriesTitle} is off
occurrence_skipped.body: The host skipped the game on {startsAt}. You’re still a regular.

occurrence_updated.title: {seriesTitle} changed
occurrence_updated.body: The host updated the game on {startsAt}. Check the details.

occurrence_rescheduled.title: {seriesTitle} has a new schedule
occurrence_rescheduled.body: The game on {startsAt} moved. Check the new dates.

peer_rating_open.title: Rate your co-players
peer_rating_open.body: Rating is open for 48 hours after the game. It’s private and keeps teams balanced.

friend_request.title: New friend request
friend_request.body: Someone you played with wants to be friends.

friend_accepted.title: Friend request accepted
friend_accepted.body: You’re friends now. You’ll see the games they join.

media_tag_request.title: You were tagged in a photo
media_tag_request.body: The tag shows only after you accept it.

media_blocked.title: Your photo wasn’t published
media_blocked.body: It didn’t pass our content checks. Nobody else can see it.

rating_level_changed.title: Your level changed
rating_level_changed.body: Your new level is {level}. See how it moved on your profile.
